prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI feedback-to-next-practice concept
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for complete feedback state and information architecture only.
Primary request: Redesign 14-E-01-short-answer-feedback/complete.
Direction: review-to-next-practice flow.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Preserve complete state: score summary, four insight cards, sentence correction summary, recommended practice cards, and a strong next-action area for retry, next problem, save, and comparison report. One dark #09090b primary CTA; secondary actions outlined or text.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design Dashboard/Card/List/Button UI, compact workspace, 4-8px app panel radii.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian neutral stack; muted semantic chips only when paired with text/icons; no chromatic CTA.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans, readable Korean feedback text, compact hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: completed feedback/result state must be unmistakable; the next recommended action should be clear; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, loud AI gradients, repeated colorful buttons, heavy shadows, fake loading or error state, raw debug strings, watermark.
